description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudFront Origin Access Control Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across OAC topologies (basic S3 origin with OAC, SSE-KMS-encrypted bucket with sigv4 signing and KMS key policy, OAI-to-OAC zero-downtime migration, multi-distribution to single shared bucket with SourceArn list, Website Endpoint prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Basic CloudFront OAC for S3 origin
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — standard OAC with S3 origin, always-sign signing, bucket policy with cloudfront.amazonaws.com and AWS:SourceArn
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudFront Origin Access Control for distribution EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE serving S3 bucket my-assets-bucket in us-east-1. Account 111122223333. The bucket is private (no website hosting). Use sigv4 signing with always-sign behavior. Tags: Environment=production, Team=platform.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDFRONT_OAC: EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE → my-assets-bucket (E2QWRUOACID123)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] S3 bucket: my-assets-bucket (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Origin type: S3 (not Website Endpoint)
  [✓] OAC created: E2QWRUOACID123 (SigningBehavior: always-sign)
  [✓] Distribution origin: EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE → OriginAccessControlId=E2QWRUOACID123
  [✓] S3 bucket policy: cloudfront.amazonaws.com s3:GetObject with AWS:SourceArn=arn:aws:cloudfront::111122223333:distribution/EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE
  [✓] Bucket public access: blocked (OAC only)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudfront get-origin-access-control --id E2QWRUOACID123
  aws cloudfront get-distribution-config --id EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket my-assets-bucket

eval_cases.name: CloudFront OAC with SSE-KMS-encrypted S3 bucket
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SSE-KMS bucket requires sigv4 always-sign, S3 bucket policy, AND KMS key policy granting cloudfront.amazonaws.com kms:Decrypt
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudFront OAC for distribution E2QWRUEXAMPLE2 serving S3 bucket my-secure-data-bucket in us-east-1, account 111122223333. The bucket is encrypted with SSE-KMS using key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. No website hosting. Tags: Environment=production, Encryption=sse-kms.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDFRONT_OAC: E2QWRUEXAMPLE2 → my-secure-data-bucket (E3KMSOACID456)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] S3 bucket: my-secure-data-bucket (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Origin type: S3 (not Website Endpoint)
  [✓] OAC created: E3KMSOACID456 (SigningBehavior: always-sign)
  [✓] S3 bucket policy: cloudfront.amazonaws.com s3:GetObject with AWS:SourceArn
  [✓] SSE-KMS: enabled (KMS key policy grants cloudfront.amazonaws.com kms:Decrypt)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudfront get-origin-access-control --id E3KMSOACID456
  aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket my-secure-data-bucket
  aws kms get-key-policy --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab --policy-name default

eval_cases.name: Zero-downtime migration from OAI to OAC
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — add OAC alongside OAI, update bucket policy with both grants, update distribution, verify, then remove OAI
eval_cases.prompt: Migrate distribution E3EXAMPLE3XXX from Origin Access Identity (OAI E3OAIID1234) to Origin Access Control. S3 bucket is my-legacy-bucket in us-east-1, account 111122223333. The OAI canonical user ID is 1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j. Need zero downtime. Tags: Environment=production, Migration=oai-to-oac.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDFRONT_OAC: E3EXAMPLE3XXX → my-legacy-bucket (E4MIGOACID789)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] S3 bucket: my-legacy-bucket (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] OAC created: E4MIGOACID789 (SigningBehavior: always-sign)
  [✓] OAI migration: zero-downtime flow (add OAC → both active → verify → remove OAI)
  [✓] S3 bucket policy: cloudfront.amazonaws.com grant added (OAI grant retained during transition)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudfront get-origin-access-control --id E4MIGOACID789
  aws cloudfront get-distribution-config --id E3EXAMPLE3XXX
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket my-legacy-bucket

eval_cases.name: Multiple CloudFront distributions serving one S3 bucket via OAC
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — three distributions each with own OAC, bucket policy lists all distribution ARNs in AWS:SourceArn condition
eval_cases.prompt: Create OACs for three CloudFront distributions (EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE, E2QWRUEXAMPLE2, E3EXAMPLE3XXX) all serving from S3 bucket shared-content-bucket in us-east-1, account 111122223333. Each distribution needs its own OAC. The bucket is private, no SSE-KMS. Tags: Environment=production, Pattern=multi-distribution.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDFRONT_OAC: EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE + E2QWRUEXAMPLE2 + E3EXAMPLE3XXX → shared-content-bucket
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] S3 bucket: shared-content-bucket (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Multi-distribution: 3 distributions in bucket policy SourceArn list
  [✓] S3 bucket policy: cloudfront.amazonaws.com s3:GetObject with AWS:SourceArn list (3 ARNs)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket shared-content-bucket
  aws cloudfront list-distributions

eval_cases.name: OAC requested for S3 bucket with website hosting enabled (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — bucket has static website hosting enabled; OAC only supports the S3 origin type, not Website Endpoint
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudFront OAC for distribution E4EXAMPLE4XXX serving S3 bucket my-website-bucket in us-east-1, account 111122223333. The bucket has static website hosting enabled with index.html as the index document. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDFRONT_OAC: E4EXAMPLE4XXX → my-website-bucket
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Origin type: FAIL (bucket has website hosting enabled — OAC only supports S3 origin type, not Website Endpoint)
